description: Bike&Ride is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. Nützliche Informationen rund um die Themen Bike&Ride Wenn die Daten der Verkehrsverbund Rhein-Ruhr AöR (VRR AöR) Bestandteil des OpenStreetMap Datenbankwerkes werden, genügt eine Nennung der VRR AöR in der Liste der Beitragenden. Eine Nennung der VRR AöR bei jeder Verwendung der Daten auch durch Lizenznehmer des oben genannten Datenbankwerks ist dann nicht mehr erforderlich. Coverage: Open.NRW. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
